mexico.summary: Visa-free for tourism for up to 180 days.
notes: The immigration officer determines your permitted stay; 180 days is not guaranteed.
mexico.passport: Valid for the duration of your stay.

japan.summary: Visa-free for tourism for up to 90 days.
japan.passport: Valid for the duration of your stay.

portugal.summary: Visa-free for tourism for up to 90 days in any 180-day period.
notes: The limit covers your combined stays across the Schengen area.
ETIAS applications are not yet open; check the latest requirements before travel.
portugal.passport: Valid for at least 3 months after leaving the Schengen area.

italy.summary: Visa-free for tourism for up to 90 days in any 180-day period.
notes: The limit covers your combined stays across the Schengen area.
ETIAS applications are not yet open; check the latest requirements before travel.
italy.passport: Valid for at least 3 months after leaving the Schengen area.

notes: Check the permitted length of stay in the official guidance or with Argentine authorities.
argentina.passport: Valid for the duration of your stay.

thailand.summary: Visa-free for tourism for up to 30 days.
notes: Complete the Thailand Digital Arrival Card before arrival.
thailand.passport: Valid for at least 6 months upon entry.

notes: An eVisa before travel or a 30-day visa on arrival is available to Canadian passport holders.
Different conditions apply to some Sinai-only visits; see official guidance.
egypt.passport: Valid for at least 6 months after your expected departure from Egypt.

new-zealand.summary: Visa-free for tourism for up to 90 days; NZeTA required.
notes: Obtain your NZeTA before travel. The tourism levy and a New Zealand Traveller Declaration also apply.
new-zealand.passport: Valid for at least 3 months after your expected departure from New Zealand.

united-states.summary: Visa-free tourism is generally permitted for up to 6 months.
notes: The border officer determines admission and your permitted stay. Some travellers face exceptions.
united-states.passport: For air travel, a Canadian passport must be valid for the duration of your stay.

notes: Eligible regular Canadian passport holders can apply for an eVisa for up to 90 days; entry-point and visa conditions apply.
vietnam.passport: Valid for at least 6 months beyond your expected departure from Vietnam.

colombia.summary: Visa-free for tourism for up to 90 days.
notes: Complete the Check-Mig immigration form. An entry fee applies to many Canadian visitors; exemptions exist.
colombia.passport: Valid for the duration of your stay.

morocco.summary: Visa-free for tourism for stays of less than 90 days.
morocco.passport: Valid for at least 6 months beyond your expected departure from Morocco.
